# IMatch.RoundEnded event

Raised on the game's thread at the end of each round, once the points are given and every runner is placed and reset for the next round, the eliminated ones back in. It is raised after the last round too.

public event EventHandler<RoundEndedEventArgs>? RoundEnded;
